card: Sets the prevout index to 0 for the double-spend transaction pair in miner unit test TestBasicMining. Previously, the test reused a transaction whose prevout was reset with SetNull(), leaving the output index as NULL_INDEX and causing template creation to fail due to a nonexistent input rather than the double spend. This ensures the unit test correctly exercises the double-spend failure condition during block assembly.
changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch or description; the patch is now recorded.
evidence: PR description: "The output index therefore stays COutPoint::NULL_INDEX, so both transactions spend an output of txFirst[0] that does not exist. Set the output index to 0, so the first transaction is a valid spend and only the second one makes fail."
Commit message: "Template creation therefore failed on a missing input even without a second spend."
problem: In `TestBasicMining`, the double-spend test case was meant to verify that block template construction fails when two mempool transactions spend the same coin. Because `prevout.n` was left as `COutPoint::NULL_INDEX`, template construction failed prematurely due to a missing outpoint rather than exercising the double-spend detection.

risk.why: A mistake would only affect a single unit test case in miner_tests.

summary: Sets the output index to 0 on a test transaction in `MinerTestingSetup::TestBasicMining`. Previously, the test reused a transaction whose prevout had been cleared with `SetNull()`, leaving the output index as `COutPoint::NULL_INDEX`. This ensures the first transaction references a valid output so the test actually verifies template creation failure caused by a double spend.
